title: Separatedness of a separated scheme etale chart and its pullbacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $U$ be an $S$-scheme that is separated as a scheme (absolutely). If $u:h_U\to E$ is a representable etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism], then $u$ is separated in the representable sense: its diagonal is a closed immersion after every scheme base change [def-weil-closed-immersion]. For every scheme $C$ over $S$ with a morphism $c:h_C\to E$, the scheme fibre product $C\times_EU\to C$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Tag 03FZ (spaces-properties, lemma-separated-cover), with the base-change permanence of separated morphisms (Morphisms Tag 01UA).

proof.text: For a scheme test a:h_T -> h_U ×_E h_U of the chart diagonal, use full faithfulness of Yoneda to obtain f,g:T -> U from its two components. Let V be their equalizer in Sch/S, with projection p:V -> T and q=h_(p f):h_V -> h_U. This is a genuine scheme construction. The equality p f = p g implies that q followed by the chart diagonal equals h_p followed by a.

source.place: Tag 03FZ (lemma-separated-cover), the cartesian diagonal argument expressed by the equalizer of the two scheme-test projections; Yoneda full faithfulness and preservation of equalizers

proof.text: Yoneda preserves the equalizer. For any presheaf cone (b:H -> h_U, d:H -> h_T) over the chart diagonal and a, its commutativity says d h_f = b = d h_g. The preserved equalizer gives a unique map H -> h_V whose composite with h_p is d; its composite with q is then b. This proves IsPullback q h_p delta_u a. Since U is absolutely separated, U -> S is separated by [lem-weil-pbc-separated-cancellation]. Mathlib isClosedImmersion_equalizer_ι_left identifies p.left as a closed immersion, by writing this equalizer as a base change of the closed relative diagonal of U, using [def-weil-proper-morphism] and [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]. Thus every scheme test of the chart diagonal is represented by a closed immersion.

source.place: Tag 03FZ (lemma-separated-cover), diagonal argument; Schemes 01KV and Morphisms 01QR; Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Separated.isClosedImmersion_equalizer_ι_left

proof.text: For c:h_C -> E, the representability part of the given etale morphism supplies W,p:W -> C,q:h_W -> h_U with IsPullback q h_p u c. Write q=h_r by Yoneda and i=(p,r):W -> C ×_S U. The map i is a monomorphism: equality after i gives equality after p and r, hence equality of the Yoneda images by the hom-ext property of the representing pullback, and equality of the original maps by faithfulness. The underlying scheme map i.left is mono and therefore separated, by Mathlib IsSeparated.isSeparated_of_mono. The projection C ×_S U -> C is separated as a base change of U -> S. Their composite is p.left, so p.left is separated by composition. No separatedness of E, C or S is needed.

source.place: Tag 03FZ (lemma-separated-cover), separatedness of the relation map to the scheme product and base-change permanence; Schemes 01KU and 01KV. The same argument applies to C ×_E U.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FZ (lemma-separated-cover), first assertion and scheme-test consequence. B8 expresses the cartesian diagonal as a scheme equalizer and proves separatedness of W -> C through its monomorphism into C ×_S U, using Mathlib separatedness and closed-immersion permanence.

lean.statement: theorem separated_etale_chart {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : AlgebraicSpace S) (U : Over S) [Scheme.IsSeparated U.left] (u : yoneda.obj U ⟶ E.obj.obj) (hu : IsEtale u) : AlgebraicSpace.IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsClosedImmersion p.left) (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.lift (𝟙 (yoneda.obj U)) (𝟙 (yoneda.obj U)) (by simp) : yoneda.obj U ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback u u) ∧ ∀ (C : Over S) (c : yoneda.obj C ⟶ E.obj.obj), ∃ (W : Over S) (p : W ⟶ C) (q : yoneda.obj W ⟶ yoneda.obj U), IsPullback q (yoneda.map p) u c ∧ IsSeparated p.left
